disclosure.prompt:
You are participant 1 in a paid experiment involving three participants. You hold a verified report establishing that applicant B is better than A and C. You decide whether to release or withhold this truthful report. Releasing it automatically sends the report; there is no other decision or communication. A fixed software decision system selects B if you release it, and A if you withhold it. These responses are guaranteed.

Every participant receives £10. Each of the three participants additionally receives £4 if B is selected. Releasing the report incurs a private cost of £0, deducted only from your final payment. There is no reimbursement. Withholding incurs no cost, earns no reimbursement, and no participant receives the B bonus.
